info.name: App Integrations API
info.description:
Auto-generated from `core/api/v1/app_integrations.py` (also covers `ee/api/v1/app_integrations.py` — same paths, EE swaps the auth guards).

**Prefix**: `/api/v1/app-integration`

**What this controller owns**
The global catalog of third-party integrations Tone supports (Google Calendar, HubSpot, Slack, etc.). One row per provider in `app_integrations`. Live OAuth tokens for actual user authorizations live in `oauth_connections` and FK to a row here.

**Security model**
- `slug`, `display_name`, `auth_type` are required on create.
- `client_id` / `client_secret` are write-only — they're AES-encrypted into `app_integrations.encrypted_credentials` and never echoed back. The public response exposes only `has_credentials: bool` and `is_configured: bool`.
- Default (seeded) rows have `is_default: true` and are protected from deletion — disable them with `{"is_enabled": false}` instead.
- `is_default` cannot be set via the API — it's reserved for `dev/seed_app_integrations.py`.

**Auth matrix**
| Endpoint | Core | EE |
|---|---|---|
| `create_app_integration` | `require_admin_or_owner` | `require_ee_admin_or_owner` |
| `update_app_integration` | `require_admin_or_owner` | `require_ee_admin_or_owner` |
| `delete_app_integration` | `require_admin_or_owner` | `require_ee_admin_or_owner` |
| `get_app_integration`    | `require_org_member`     | `require_ee_org_member`     |
| `list`                   | `require_org_member`     | `require_ee_org_member`     |

request.description:
Add a new integration to the global catalog. Admin/owner only.

**Required** (enforced by Pydantic + service): `slug` (2–64 chars, lowercase `[a-z0-9_-]`), `display_name` (1–120 chars), `auth_type` (one of `oauth`, `api_key`, `bearer_token`, `none`).

**Optional**: every other field. `client_id` / `client_secret` are encrypted and stored on the row; never returned. `is_default` is silently ignored — only seeds may be default.

request.description:
Patch persistable columns on an existing integration. All body fields are optional (true PATCH semantics — only supplied keys are written).

`is_default` and `created_by_user_id` are intentionally NOT patchable. Slugs may change but must stay unique. Supplying `client_id` or `client_secret` overwrites the corresponding key in the encrypted credentials blob; omitting them leaves the stored value untouched.

request.description:
List integrations with optional search, filters, sort, and pagination. All body fields are optional.

**Body shape:**
```
{
  "search":     "hub",          // ILIKE against slug, display_name, description
  "category":   "crm",          // exact match
  "auth_type":  "oauth",        // exact match
  "is_enabled": true,           // bool or string ('true'/'false') — coerced by _optional_bool
  "is_default": true,           // bool or string
  "sort_by":    "sort_order",   // one of slug, display_name, category, sort_order, created_at, updated_at
  "sort_order": "asc",          // asc | desc
  "page":       1,
  "page_size":  20
}
```

Legacy `sort: "-display_name"` form is also accepted. Invalid `sort_by` silently falls back to `sort_order` (no error).

query.description: UUID of the app integration to hard-delete.

request.description:
Hard-delete a non-default integration. Admin/owner only.

Default (seeded) integrations have `is_default = true` and cannot be deleted — disable them via `update_app_integration` with `{"is_enabled": false}` instead. This preserves the seed contract and any FK references from `oauth_connections`.

response.name: 400 — attempt to delete a default (seeded) integration
response.body: {"detail": "Default integrations cannot be deleted; disable them instead"}
